title: WorkForceAgent-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLM-based Web Agents via Reinforcement Learning
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2026
authors_zh: Yuchen Zhuang、Di Jin、Jiaao Chen、Wenqi Shi、Hanrui Wang、Chao Zhang
paper_type_zh: 网页智能体强化学习与规则验证方法
best_for_zh: 关注 environment-agent trajectory、WorkArena、RLVR verifier、失败样本保留与复现审计的读者
one_line: WorkForceAgent-R1 turns filtered WorkArena oracle trajectories into single-step action-verification problems for SFT and GRPO, but releases code without the trajectory corpus, rejection ledger, or trained checkpoints.
WorkForceAgent-R1 将筛选后的 WorkArena oracle 轨迹拆成单步动作验证样本，用规则奖励进行 SFT 与 GRPO，但未公开轨迹语料、淘汰记录或训练后模型。
why: It isolates a cheap rule-based feedback contract for workplace web-agent reasoning while showing why paper-scale configurations, derived records, public artifacts, proxy rewards, and complete success/failure retention must be audited separately.
inclusion_reason: WorkForceAgent-R1 is a concrete environment-agent training recipe that converts successful WorkArena oracle trajectories into single-step goal/state/history/action examples and optimizes them with an explicit rule verifier. Its value to the track lies equally in the data/feedback contract and in the audit boundary created by an unreleased trajectory corpus.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The canonical record is the March 2026 Findings of EACL paper, ACL Anthology ID 2026.findings-eacl.3; the 2025 suffix in this Card ID reflects the earlier arXiv submission, not the formal publication year. The paper addresses a specific training problem: supervised web agents can memorize demonstrated paths, yet workplace pages change after every action and expose long HTML or accessibility-tree observations. End-to-end multi-step RL would repeatedly execute a costly remote environment, so the authors seek a cheaper signal for learning the next action with explicit reasoning.

The construction starts from WorkArena's 33 ServiceNow task types. Ten training configurations per task yield 330 reported training configurations. BrowserGym cheat() functions execute Playwright scripts to create oracle-like sequences of actions and observations. Invalid-action or unsuccessful trajectories are removed, and each retained sequence is split into independent decision records. A record combines the natural-language goal, current HTML/AXTree observation, previous actions, available operations, and the oracle next action; SFT may also attach teacher-generated reasoning, while GRPO attaches sampled <think>...</think><action>...</action> completions and rule rewards.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because its central object is derived from interaction trajectories and its supervision is tied to environment state and action, even though the RL verifier is an offline oracle-action matcher rather than live terminal feedback. It is not a released trajectory dataset, a general web benchmark, or proof of end-to-end planning: the repository contains recipe code with external data/model placeholders, but no accepted trajectories, rejected failures, checkpoints, or replay manifest.

The Card is therefore useful as an auditable construction and feedback recipe. Its L3 boundary is deliberate: the paper and code are inspectable, but data reuse, exact replay, failure-distribution analysis, and model reuse remain blocked by missing artifacts. (Paper §§4.1–4.3; official repository at 1ee2619b….)

权威记录是 2026 年 3 月发表于 Findings of EACL 的正式论文，ACL Anthology ID 为 2026.findings-eacl.3；Card ID 中的 2025 来自更早的 arXiv 投稿年份，不代表正式出版年份。论文处理的是一个具体训练难题：SFT 网页智能体可能记住示范路径，而企业网页会在每次动作后改变，并产生很长的 HTML 或 accessibility tree 观测；若直接进行端到端多步 RL，又需要反复执行昂贵的远程环境。因此，作者希望用更便宜的信号训练带显式推理的下一步动作选择。

构造过程从 WorkArena 的 33 类 ServiceNow 任务开始。每类保留 10 个训练配置，因此论文报告的是 330 个训练配置。BrowserGym 的 cheat() 函数执行 Playwright 脚本，生成 oracle-like 动作—观测序列；随后删除含无效动作或最终失败的轨迹，再把每条保留轨迹拆成独立决策记录。单条记录包含自然语言目标、当前 HTML/AXTree、历史动作、可用操作和 oracle 下一动作；SFT 还可附带 teacher 生成的 reasoning，GRPO 则附加模型采样的 <think>...</think><action>...</action> 输出与规则奖励。

它属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为核心对象源自环境交互轨迹，监督信号绑定到状态与动作；但 RL verifier 是离线 oracle-action matcher，不是实时 terminal feedback。它也不是已公开的轨迹数据集、通用网页 benchmark 或端到端规划证明：官方仓库只提供带外部数据/模型占位符的配方代码，没有公开已接收轨迹、被拒失败样本、checkpoint 或 replay manifest。

因此，本 Card 的价值是提供可审计的构造与反馈配方。L3 边界是有意保留的：论文和代码可以检查，但数据复用、精确复现、失败分布分析和模型复用仍受缺失 artifact 阻断。（论文 §§4.1–4.3；官方仓库固定于 1ee2619b…。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is to turn a dynamic, multi-step browser episode into a collection of single-step reasoning problems whose answers can be scored without executing every candidate in WorkArena.

The data object has two layers. The upstream layer is a successful oracle-like trajectory (a0,o0,…,aT,oT) produced by BrowserGym/Playwright for one WorkArena configuration. The downstream training layer is a state/action record: task goal, current webpage content, action history, action definitions, and oracle next action. Standard SFT uses o3-mini-annotated trajectories; the SFT-L ablation uses DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B; GRPO samples a group of reasoning/action candidates from the policy.

The feedback contract is programmatic. It can observe whether the answer respects the <think>/<action> structure, whether the proposed operation is valid, whether its function name equals the oracle function, whether its parameters match, and whether extra tokens follow the closing action tag. The paper assigns 0.1 for format, 1 for exact action and parameters, 0.1 for action type alone, and −0.9 for post-termination tokens. It cannot observe whether the reasoning is faithful, whether a different action would also succeed, or whether the candidate completes the task. WorkArena terminal success is measured only during evaluation.

The nearest substrates are WorkArena, which defines the workplace tasks and environment success checks, and BrowserGym, which supplies standardized observations/actions and heuristic cheat() programs. The optimization scaffold comes from GRPO, veRL, and TinyZero. Relative to a conventional SFT trajectory pipeline, WorkForceAgent-R1 changes the unit of optimization and installs an explicit next-action reward; it does not introduce the environment, Playwright oracle mechanism, or GRPO itself, and it does not release a new corpus.

The resulting research direction is rule-verified agent training under expensive interaction: use environment programs to generate references, then learn from state-local decisions. The central audit question is whether the cheap proxy preserves the alternatives and long-horizon consequences that live interaction would reveal.

核心贡献是把动态、多步的浏览器 episode 转换为一组单步 reasoning 问题，使系统无需在 WorkArena 中执行每个候选动作也能评分。

数据对象有两层。上游是一条由 BrowserGym/Playwright 针对某个 WorkArena 配置生成的成功 oracle-like 轨迹 (a0,o0,…,aT,oT)；下游训练对象是一条 state/action 记录，包含任务目标、当前网页内容、动作历史、动作定义和 oracle 下一动作。标准 SFT 使用 o3-mini 标注的轨迹；SFT-L 消融使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B；GRPO 则从当前策略采样一组 reasoning/action 候选。

反馈契约是 programmatic 的。它能检查输出是否遵循 <think>/<action> 结构、动作是否属于合法操作、函数名是否等于 oracle 函数、参数是否匹配，以及结束标签后是否还有多余 token。论文规定：格式正确得 0.1，动作及参数完全正确得 1，仅动作类型正确得 0.1，</action> 后继续生成则罚 −0.9。它无法判断 reasoning 是否忠实、另一种动作是否同样有效，也无法判断候选是否最终完成任务。WorkArena terminal success 只用于评测。

最接近的基础设施是 WorkArena 和 BrowserGym：前者定义企业任务及环境成功检查，后者提供标准观测/动作接口和启发式 cheat() 程序；优化脚手架来自 GRPO、veRL 与 TinyZero。相对常规 SFT 轨迹管线，WorkForceAgent-R1 真正改变的是优化单元，并加入显式下一动作奖励；它没有新建环境、Playwright oracle 机制或 GRPO，也没有发布新语料。

这代表的研究方向是昂贵交互条件下的 rule-verified agent training：先利用环境程序生成参考动作，再从局部状态决策中学习。核心审计问题是，这个廉价 proxy 是否保留了实时交互才能揭示的可替代动作与长程后果。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. WorkArena supplies 33 ServiceNow task types and natural-language goals. The authors reserve 10 training configurations per task, for 330, use separate testing configurations, and ask o3-mini to perturb training configurations so they differ from existing BrowserGym/WorkArena configurations. The IDs, perturbation prompts, outputs, and fixed split manifest are not public.

Trajectory generation and filtering. BrowserGym cheat() functions run Playwright scripts to produce oracle-like action/observation sequences. The paper removes samples with invalid actions or unsuccessful outcomes. It gives no attempted, accepted, rejected, or per-task trajectory counts, so “330 configurations” must not be rewritten as “330 released trajectories.”

Record transformation. Each accepted episode is decomposed into independent steps. A training input contains the goal, current HTML/AXTree observation, previous actions, and action definitions; the reference is the next structured action. The paper's notation omits future observations from a step record. Standard SFT attaches o3-mini reasoning; SFT-L injects longer reasoning from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B.

SFT and rollout. The RL initialization uses one SFT epoch on 1,000 randomly selected records, batch size 32, and learning rate 1e-4. At each GRPO state the policy samples G candidates. The paper does not numerically disclose G; the pinned public script sets rollout.n=8, temperature 0.6, and maximum response length 1,024, but no run manifest proves that every paper result used this exact file.

Verifier and optimizer. The paper's total reward is R = Rf + Rs + Rp: Rf=0.1 for valid structured output; Rs=1 for exact action type and parameters, 0.1 for type alone, else zero; Rp=-0.9 if tokens follow </action>. GRPO computes group-relative advantages with clipping and KL regularization. Paper-level RL uses batch 128, LR 1e-5, rollout temperature 0.6, and KL coefficient 1e-3 on eight H200 141GB GPUs.

Outputs and evaluation. Outputs are fine-tuned Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B policies and a Llama-3.1-8B transfer result, evaluated by WorkArena success rate. No trained checkpoint or evaluation episode log is linked.

Reproduction audit. Pin ACL paper/arXiv version, code SHA, BrowserGym, WorkArena/ServiceNow state, Playwright, veRL/TinyZero, teacher snapshots, configuration IDs, random seeds, data/checkpoint hashes, and reward tests. The public preprocessor independently calls train_test_split for train and test, and pinned webagent.py does not literally implement the paper equations; both differences require reconciliation before treating the repository as an exact reproduction.

输入。 WorkArena 提供 33 类 ServiceNow 任务和自然语言目标。作者为每类任务保留 10 个训练配置，共 330 个；测试配置另行划分，并使用 o3-mini 扰动训练配置，使其区别于既有 BrowserGym/WorkArena 配置。配置 ID、扰动 prompt 与输出、固定 split manifest 均未公开。

轨迹生成与过滤。 BrowserGym 的 cheat() 函数执行 Playwright 脚本，生成 oracle-like 动作—观测序列。论文删除包含无效动作或最终失败的样本，但没有报告尝试、接收、拒绝及各任务轨迹数量，因此不能把“330 个配置”改写成“330 条已公开轨迹”。

记录转换。 每条保留 episode 被拆成独立步骤。训练输入含目标、当前 HTML/AXTree、历史动作和动作定义，参考输出是下一个结构化动作；论文的单步表示不包含未来观测。标准 SFT 附加 o3-mini reasoning，SFT-L 则从 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 注入更长 reasoning。

SFT 与 rollout。 RL 初始化先在随机抽取的 1,000 条记录上做 1 个 epoch 的 SFT，batch size 32，学习率 1e-4。GRPO 在每个状态采样 G 个候选；论文正文没有给出 G 的数值。固定版本的公开脚本设置 rollout.n=8、temperature 0.6、最大响应长度 1,024，但没有 run manifest 证明所有论文结果都使用该文件。

Verifier 与优化器。 论文总奖励为 R = Rf + Rs + Rp：结构合法时 Rf=0.1；动作类型及参数完全正确时 Rs=1，仅类型正确时为 0.1，否则为 0；</action> 后继续生成时 Rp=-0.9。GRPO 使用组相对优势、裁剪与 KL 正则。论文报告 RL batch 128、学习率 1e-5、rollout temperature 0.6、KL 系数 1e-3，使用 8 张 141GB H200。

输出与评测。 输出是经过训练的 Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B 策略以及 Llama-3.1-8B 迁移结果，并用 WorkArena success rate 评测；官方未链接训练后 checkpoint 或评测 episode log。

复现审计。 需要固定 ACL/arXiv 版本、代码 SHA、BrowserGym、WorkArena/ServiceNow 状态、Playwright、veRL/TinyZero、teacher snapshot、配置 ID、随机种子、数据/checkpoint hash 与 reward 测试。公开预处理器分别调用 train_test_split 构造训练集和测试集，固定版本的 webagent.py 也没有逐字实现论文奖励公式；在把仓库当作精确复现前，必须解释这两类差异。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates success rate on WorkArena's seven workplace categories: dashboard, form, knowledge, filter, sort, menu, and service. “Overall” is weighted by the number of tasks in each category. These are author-reported results; this Card did not reproduce training or evaluation because neither the data nor checkpoints are public.

| Backbone / training | Overall success rate | Change reported in Table 1 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct | 2.62 | reference | | Qwen2.5-3B SFT | 26.59 | +23.97 vs. base | | WorkForceAgent-R1 3B | 36.85 | +10.26 vs. SFT | | Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct | 9.42 | reference | | Qwen2.5-7B SFT | 27.32 | +17.90 vs. base | | WorkForceAgent-R1 7B | 39.56 | +12.24 vs. SFT | | Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct | 23.79 | reference | | Qwen2.5-14B SFT | 30.20 | +6.41 vs. base | | WorkForceAgent-R1 14B | 46.79 | +16.59 vs. SFT |

For context, Table 1 reports GPT-4o at 42.65, GPT-4.1 at 48.19, and o4-mini at 55.78. Thus the 14B result exceeds the listed GPT-4o result by 4.14 points, but not the strongest proprietary baselines. The paper text's “4.99%” comparison does not equal the table's 46.79−42.65 arithmetic, so the table values should be cited directly rather than repeating that derived claim.

Backbone transfer is positive but smaller in absolute level. On Llama-3.1-8B, Table 2 gives 8.57 for Instruct, 20.48 for SFT, 24.56 for SFT-L, and 32.41 for WorkForceAgent-R1, a +23.84-point change from Instruct.

Training conditions matter: the reported warm-up uses 1,000 randomly selected samples for one epoch; RL uses batch 128, temperature 0.6, KL 1e-3, and eight H200 GPUs. Figure 7 shows warm-up GRPO outperforming direct Instruct-PPO and Instruct-GRPO for the 7B model. Figure 6 reports GRPO at 39.56 versus PPO at 36.08. In the reward ablation, sparse rewards are more stable; fully dense similarity rewards collapse toward a frequent click('a324'), while piecewise dense rewards encourage excessive actions after the termination tag (Paper Figures 6–8, §5.4).

The evidence supports a useful optimization recipe on WorkArena. It does not establish data quality independently: failures were filtered out, record counts are missing, the same task families underlie training and evaluation, and the released implementation cannot reproduce the reported run without private inputs.

论文在 WorkArena 的七类企业任务上报告 success rate：dashboard、form、knowledge、filter、sort、menu 和 service；“Overall” 按各类别任务数加权。以下均为作者报告结果。由于数据和 checkpoint 未公开，本 Card 没有独立复现训练或评测。

| Backbone / 训练方式 | Overall success rate | Table 1 报告的变化 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct | 2.62 | 参考值 | | Qwen2.5-3B SFT | 26.59 | 相对 base +23.97 | | WorkForceAgent-R1 3B | 36.85 | 相对 SFT +10.26 | | Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct | 9.42 | 参考值 | | Qwen2.5-7B SFT | 27.32 | 相对 base +17.90 | | WorkForceAgent-R1 7B | 39.56 | 相对 SFT +12.24 | | Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct | 23.79 | 参考值 | | Qwen2.5-14B SFT | 30.20 | 相对 base +6.41 | | WorkForceAgent-R1 14B | 46.79 | 相对 SFT +16.59 |

作为参照，Table 1 中 GPT-4o 为 42.65，GPT-4.1 为 48.19，o4-mini 为 55.78。因此 14B 结果比表中的 GPT-4o 高 4.14 个点，但没有超过最强 proprietary baseline。论文正文所称“4.99%”与表中 46.79−42.65 的算术结果不一致，引用时应直接使用表格数值，不宜重复该派生说法。

Backbone 迁移同样呈正向变化，但绝对水平较低。Table 2 中 Llama-3.1-8B 的 Instruct、SFT、SFT-L 和 WorkForceAgent-R1 分别为 8.57、20.48、24.56、32.41；相对 Instruct 提升 23.84 个点。

训练条件不可忽略：warm-up 在随机抽取的 1,000 条样本上训练 1 个 epoch；RL 使用 batch 128、temperature 0.6、KL 1e-3 和 8 张 H200。Figure 7 显示 7B 模型的 warm-up GRPO 优于直接从 Instruct 初始化的 PPO/GRPO；Figure 6 报告 GRPO 为 39.56、PPO 为 36.08。奖励消融中，sparse reward 更稳定；fully dense similarity reward 退化为频繁输出 click('a324')，piecewise dense reward 则诱导结束标签后的过量动作（Figures 6–8，§5.4）。

这些证据支持其作为 WorkArena 优化配方的价值，却不能独立证明 data quality：失败轨迹被过滤、记录总数缺失、训练与评测共享任务家族，而且公开实现缺少私有输入，无法重现论文运行。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is a trajectory-level SFT pipeline: collect (action, observation) sequences from browser tasks, optionally annotate reasoning with a strong model, and behavior-clone the reference actions. WorkArena already supplies the enterprise tasks and task-level success checks; BrowserGym already supplies observation/action interfaces and heuristic cheat() programs; GRPO, veRL, TinyZero, Playwright, and the Qwen/Llama backbones are reused components.

WorkForceAgent-R1's concrete change is the interface between trajectory data and reinforcement learning. A successful multi-step oracle trace is not optimized as one online episode. It is split into state-local decisions, and a policy candidate receives a composite rule score for structure, function name, parameters, and termination. This makes group-relative optimization possible without running every sampled action through the remote WorkArena environment. The SFT warm-up and GRPO stages then share the same next-action object.

For reasoning-data research, the directional novelty is more important than a broad “R1-style” label: the method treats an environment program as a source of reference actions, transforms episode histories into verifier-addressable records, and explicitly exposes the proxy between action equivalence and terminal success. The reward ablation also demonstrates that more granular similarity credit can be easier to game than a sparse contract.

Several claims should not be inflated. The method does not introduce WorkArena, BrowserGym, GRPO, or oracle scripting; it does not verify the truth of <think> text; and it does not release a new dataset or model family. The 330 configurations are a paper construction scale, not a public artifact count. Improvements on the same WorkArena task families show configuration-level transfer within that substrate, not general web autonomy.

Before reuse, check whether alternative valid actions are accepted, whether failures are retained, whether the paper reward and code scorer agree, whether train/test IDs are disjoint, and whether environment versions are replayable. Without those checks, the new feedback interface may be easy to implement but hard to audit.

前序基线是轨迹级 SFT 管线：从浏览器任务收集 (action, observation) 序列，可选地用强模型补充 reasoning，再对参考动作做 behavior cloning。WorkArena 已经提供企业任务与任务级成功检查，BrowserGym 已提供观测/动作接口和启发式 cheat() 程序；GRPO、veRL、TinyZero、Playwright 以及 Qwen/Llama backbone 也都是复用组件。

WorkForceAgent-R1 的具体变化发生在轨迹数据与强化学习之间的接口。成功的多步 oracle 轨迹并不作为一个在线 episode 直接优化，而是被拆成局部状态决策；每个策略候选根据结构、函数名、参数和终止位置获得复合规则分数。这样，系统无需把每个采样动作都送入远程 WorkArena 执行，也能进行组相对优化；SFT warm-up 与 GRPO 随后共享同一种下一动作对象。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向性新意比宽泛的“R1-style”标签更重要：该方法把环境程序当作参考动作来源，把 episode history 转换成 verifier 可寻址的记录，并显式暴露动作等价性与 terminal success 之间的 proxy。奖励消融还表明，更细粒度的 similarity credit 可能比 sparse contract 更容易被利用。

但不能放大若干结论。该方法没有创建 WorkArena、BrowserGym、GRPO 或 oracle scripting，也不验证 <think> 文本的真实性；它没有发布新数据集或模型家族。330 个配置是论文构造规模，不是公开 artifact 数量。在相同 WorkArena 任务家族上的提升说明的是该 substrate 内的配置级迁移，而不是通用网页自治。

复用前需要检查：是否接受替代性有效动作、失败是否保留、论文奖励与代码 scorer 是否一致、train/test ID 是否互斥、环境版本能否 replay。若这些问题没有解决，新反馈接口虽然易于实现，却难以审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Proxy false negatives. Exact oracle-action matching can score a different but valid navigation action as wrong. Because sampled candidates are not executed, the verifier cannot detect equivalent paths or recovery strategies. This is a curator inference from the stated surrogate contract.
  • Reasoning is unverified. Tags and actions are checked, but the content inside <think> is not compared with state transitions or causal evidence. Higher action reward therefore does not prove faithful reasoning.
  • Dropped failures. The construction removes invalid-action and unsuccessful trajectories before training. No rejection count, IDs, raw failed records, or per-task acceptance rates are released, so selection bias and failure coverage cannot be measured.
  • Release gap. The repository ships code with unresolved external data-path and model-path fields, not the 330 configurations, accepted trajectories, derived records, teacher annotations, GRPO samples, evaluation episodes, or trained checkpoints. Complete successful and failed trajectories are both unavailable.
  • Paper/code drift. At commit 1ee2619b…, webagent.py relaxes several tag checks, uses scores on a different scale from Rf+Rs+Rp, and contains a postfix-length branch inconsistent with its labels/comments. The preprocessor also derives train and test with separate train_test_split calls. No run manifest binds the reported experiments to corrected code.
  • Reward hacking. The paper directly observes dense-reward variants collapsing toward a frequent click or generating excessive post-termination actions. The sparse design is more stable, but the authors still list superficial reward hacking as a limitation.
  • Benchmark overlap. Training and testing configurations are reported separate, yet both use the same 33 WorkArena task types and ServiceNow substrate. No broader browser-domain evaluation or model-training contamination audit is reported.
  • Hidden teacher traits. o3-mini perturbs configs and annotates SFT reasoning; DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B supplies SFT-L reasoning. Exact versions, prompts, outputs, sampling controls, costs, and filtering are unknown.
  • Replay and versioning. WorkArena is remote-hosted; ServiceNow state, BrowserGym/Playwright versions, container/database snapshots, configuration IDs, split seed, and checkpoint hashes are not pinned. The repository has no tag or GitHub Release.
  • Rights boundary. The ACL paper is CC BY 4.0, but no root LICENSE covers the code repository, and unavailable training data/checkpoints have unknown terms. Apache headers on inherited files cannot be generalized to the entire release.
  • Author-stated scope. The paper notes a gap to stronger commercial models, limited generalization beyond workplace browsing, and residual reward-hacking risk. Benchmark scores should not be treated as proof of data quality or safe deployment.

• Proxy false negative。 精确 oracle-action matching 可能把另一种同样有效的导航动作判错；由于候选并未实际执行，verifier 无法识别等价路径或恢复策略。这是根据论文 surrogate contract 得出的 curator inference。
  • Reasoning 未验证。 系统检查标签与动作，但不把 <think> 内容同状态转移或因果证据对照；因此更高的动作奖励不能证明 reasoning 忠实。
  • 失败被丢弃。 构造过程在训练前删除无效动作和失败轨迹，且未公开拒绝数量、ID、原始失败记录或各任务接收率，因此无法衡量 selection bias 与 failure coverage。
  • 发布缺口。 仓库代码中的外部数据路径与模型路径仍未解析；仓库没有提供 330 个配置、已接收轨迹、派生记录、teacher 标注、GRPO 样本、评测 episode 或训练后 checkpoint。完整成功轨迹与失败轨迹都不可获得。
  • 论文/代码漂移。 在提交 1ee2619b… 中，webagent.py 放宽了多项标签检查，评分尺度与 Rf+Rs+Rp 不同，且 postfix-length 分支与标签/注释相冲突；预处理器还分别调用 train_test_split 生成 train 与 test。没有 run manifest 将论文实验绑定到修正后的代码。
  • Reward hacking。 论文直接观察到 dense-reward 变体退化为频繁 click，或在结束标签后持续生成动作。Sparse 设计更稳定，但作者仍把表面化 reward hacking 列为限制。
  • Benchmark overlap。 论文称训练/测试配置分离，但两者都使用相同的 33 类 WorkArena 任务和 ServiceNow substrate；没有报告更广网页领域评测或模型训练污染审计。
  • 隐藏 teacher 特征。 o3-mini 扰动配置并标注 SFT reasoning，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 提供 SFT-L reasoning；精确版本、prompt、输出、采样控制、成本和过滤规则均未知。
  • Replay 与版本。 WorkArena 为远程托管；ServiceNow 状态、BrowserGym/Playwright 版本、容器/数据库 snapshot、配置 ID、split seed 和 checkpoint hash 均未固定。仓库没有 tag 或 GitHub Release。
  • 权利边界。 ACL 论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但代码仓库没有根级 LICENSE，未公开训练数据/checkpoint 的条款也未知；不能把继承文件中的 Apache header 推广到整个 release。
  • 作者明确的范围。 论文承认与更强 commercial model 仍有差距、企业网页以外的泛化有限，并存在残余 reward-hacking 风险。Benchmark 分数不能被当作 data quality 或安全部署的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, this paper is most useful as a recipe and audit reference, not as a downloadable dataset. It shows how to convert an environment program into step-local training records: preserve the goal, current observation, action history, action schema, oracle action, candidate completion, component rewards, provenance to the source episode, and the task-level terminal result. A comparable release should also preserve rejected attempts rather than only successful oracle traces.

The reward design is a practical RLVR baseline. Implement separate tests for output structure, legal operation, function equivalence, parameter equivalence, and post-termination text; log each component before summing it. Then compare exact reference matching with environment execution or an equivalence-aware verifier to quantify false negatives. The paper's dense-reward failures provide ready-made adversarial tests: frequent-action collapse and generation after </action>.

The method also supports controlled ablations: trajectory-level SFT versus single-step SFT; direct Instruct initialization versus 1,000-sample warm-up; PPO versus GRPO; sparse versus fully/piecewise dense reward; Qwen versus Llama backbones; and within-WorkArena versus cross-domain evaluation. Any replication should publish fixed configuration IDs, split hashes, accepted/rejected counts, teacher prompts, rollout group size, seeds, environment snapshot, code SHA, and checkpoint hashes.

The public repository can serve as a reading-level implementation starting point for the preprocessing and reward interfaces, but its repository-wide license is unknown and the paper/code differences require correction. It cannot reproduce the reported experiment without external data and models.

Reuse class is reading and audit reference only; training, model, and exact evaluation reuse are blocked pending verification. The paper demonstrates SFT and RLVR uses conceptually, but the actual records and checkpoints are unavailable. Benchmark performance alone does not authorize reconstructing or claiming a “WorkForceAgent-R1 dataset,” and the absence of unsuccessful traces prevents a balanced training-quality audit.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track 而言，这篇论文最适合作为配方与审计参考，而不是可下载数据集。它展示了如何把环境程序转换为局部步骤训练记录：保留目标、当前观测、动作历史、动作 schema、oracle 动作、候选输出、各奖励分量、到源 episode 的 provenance，以及任务级 terminal result。可比发布还应保留被拒尝试，而不是只留下成功 oracle 轨迹。

其奖励设计可以作为实用 RLVR baseline。实现时应分别测试输出结构、合法操作、函数等价、参数等价和结束标签后的文本，并在求和前记录每个分量；随后把精确 reference matching 与环境执行或 equivalence-aware verifier 对比，以估计 false negative。论文中的 dense-reward 失败可直接转为对抗测试：频繁动作坍缩，以及 </action> 后继续生成。

该方法也适合受控消融：轨迹级 SFT 对比单步 SFT；直接 Instruct 初始化对比 1,000 样本 warm-up；PPO 对比 GRPO；sparse 对比 fully/piecewise dense reward；Qwen 对比 Llama backbone；WorkArena 内部评测对比跨领域评测。任何复现都应发布固定配置 ID、split hash、接收/拒绝数量、teacher prompt、rollout group size、随机种子、环境 snapshot、代码 SHA 和 checkpoint hash。

官方仓库可作为预处理和奖励接口的阅读级实现起点，但其仓库级 license 未知，且论文/代码差异需要修正；没有外部数据和模型，它无法重现论文实验。

复用等级是 仅限阅读与审计参考；训练、模型和精确评测复用在核验前均受阻。论文在概念上展示了 SFT 与 RLVR 用途，但实际记录和 checkpoint 不可获得。Benchmark performance 不能授权重建或宣称存在“WorkForceAgent-R1 数据集”；缺少失败轨迹也使平衡的训练质量审计无法进行。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Anchor bibliographic claims to ACL Anthology 2026.findings-eacl.3: this is a 2026 Findings of EACL paper, although the arXiv ID and Card ID originate in 2025.
  • Remember the object boundary: 330 is the number of reserved training configurations. The paper does not disclose the accepted full-trajectory count, derived single-step count, rejected count, or total GRPO candidates, and none of these records is publicly released.
  • Read the feedback path as WorkArena config -> BrowserGym cheat()/Playwright successful oracle trace -> single-step record -> sampled reasoning/action -> exact/partial rule score. Task-level environment success is evaluation feedback, not the RL reward for every candidate.
  • The most informative reading order is §4.1 for data construction, §4.3.3 for the reward equations, Table 1 and Table 2 for model results, Figures 6–8 for optimizer/reward failures, and the Limitations plus Privacy statement for boundary claims.
  • The easiest misreading is to infer end-to-end interactive RL. The method explicitly decomposes navigation into independent next-action decisions because dynamic observations and remote feedback are expensive.
  • Read alongside WorkArena and BrowserGym to understand the task/oracle source, and alongside GRPO/TinyZero/veRL to separate the scaffold from the paper-specific verifier; before reuse, also resolve split behavior, paper/code reward differences, exact teacher/run versions, licenses, environment snapshots, and a complete success/failure ledger.

• 书目信息以 ACL Anthology 2026.findings-eacl.3 为准：正式论文发表于 2026 年 Findings of EACL，尽管 arXiv ID 与 Card ID 源于 2025 年。
  • 牢记对象边界：330 指保留的训练配置数量。论文没有披露已接收完整轨迹数、派生单步记录数、拒绝数量或 GRPO 候选总数，这些记录也都没有公开。
  • 反馈链应读作 WorkArena 配置 -> BrowserGym cheat()/Playwright 成功 oracle 轨迹 -> 单步记录 -> 采样 reasoning/action -> 精确/部分规则分数。任务级环境成功是评测反馈，不是每个 RL 候选的奖励。
  • 推荐阅读顺序：§4.1 看数据构造，§4.3.3 看奖励公式，Table 1 与 Table 2 看模型结果，Figures 6–8 看优化器/奖励失败，再读 Limitations 和 Privacy statement 确认边界。
  • 最容易产生的误读是把它当作端到端交互式 RL。论文明确因为动态观测和远程反馈昂贵而把导航拆成独立下一动作决策。
  • 可与 WorkArena、BrowserGym 一起阅读，以理解任务/oracle 来源；再与 GRPO、TinyZero、veRL 对照，把优化脚手架与论文特有 verifier 分开。复用前还需解决 split 行为、论文/代码奖励差异、teacher/run 精确版本、license、环境 snapshot 和完整成功/失败 ledger。

value.html: The paper constructs successful oracle-like multi-step WorkArena trajectories and then decomposes them into independent single-step action-prediction records for SFT and rule-verified GRPO. Neither the trajectory corpus nor the derived record corpus is included in the public repository.

value_zh.html: 论文构造成功的类 oracle 多步 WorkArena 轨迹，再将其分解为用于 SFT 与规则验证 GRPO 的独立单步动作预测记录。轨迹语料与派生记录语料均未包含在公开仓库中。

value.html: WorkArena's 33 ServiceNow task types. The authors reserve 10 training configuration files per task (330 configurations total), keep training and testing configurations separate, and use o3-mini to perturb the training configurations so they differ from BrowserGym and WorkArena configurations. WorkArena's full 19,912-instance benchmark inventory is context, not the reported training-set size.

value_zh.html: WorkArena 的 33 种 ServiceNow 任务类型。作者每任务预留 10 个训练配置文件（共 330 个配置），保持训练与测试配置分离，并用 o3-mini 扰动训练配置使其不同于 BrowserGym 与 WorkArena 配置。WorkArena 完整 19,912 实例基准清单是上下文，而非所报告训练集规模。

value.html: The policy conditions on the current webpage HTML (examples render an accessibility tree), the natural-language goal, the previous action history, and the current action definitions. It does not receive a packaged replayable environment snapshot in the public release.

value_zh.html: 策略以当前网页 HTML（样例渲染无障碍树）、自然语言目标、先前动作历史与当前动作定义为条件。它在公开发布中不接收打包的可重放环境快照。

value.html: Structured BrowserGym web operations such as click and fill, with operation-specific parameters, principally element identifiers.

value_zh.html: 结构化 BrowserGym web 操作如 click 与 fill，带操作特定参数，主要为元素标识符。

value.html: A single-step completion contains reasoning inside <think>...</think> followed by one environment action inside <action>...</action>. The target action has an operation type such as click or fill and parameters such as an element identifier.

value_zh.html: 单步补全在 <think>...</think> 内含推理，随后在 <action>...</action> 内含一个环境动作。目标动作具有如 click 或 fill 的操作类型以及如元素标识符的参数。

value.html: BrowserGym cheat() Playwright scripts generate oracle-like action/observation trajectories. o3-mini supplies reasoning annotations for the standard SFT trajectories; DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B supplies longer reasoning for the SFT-L ablation. GRPO policy samples produce candidate reasoning/action completions during RL.

value_zh.html: BrowserGym cheat() Playwright 脚本生成类 oracle 动作/观察轨迹。o3-mini 为标准 SFT 轨迹提供推理标注；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 为 SFT-L 消融提供更长推理。GRPO 策略样本在 RL 期间产生候选推理/动作补全。

value.html: BrowserGym drives remote-hosted WorkArena tasks on ServiceNow. BrowserGym's heuristic cheat() Playwright programs supply oracle-like actions for training; WorkArena's live task execution and backend checks supply the benchmark success rate used for evaluation.

value_zh.html: BrowserGym 驱动 ServiceNow 上远程托管的 WorkArena 任务。BrowserGym 的启发式 cheat() Playwright 程序为训练提供类 oracle 动作；WorkArena 的实时任务执行与后端检查提供用于评测的基准成功率。

value.html: Training uses an offline rule verifier against the oracle action, not live terminal WorkArena feedback. The paper specifies Rf=0.1 for correct tag/action format; Rs=1 for the exact action type and parameters, Rs=0.1 for the correct action type only, otherwise 0; and Rp=-0.9 when tokens follow </action>, with R=Rf+Rs+Rp. Exact action matching is explicitly presented as a surrogate necessitated by real-time feedback constraints.

value_zh.html: 训练使用对照 oracle 动作的离线规则验证器，而非实时终态 WorkArena 反馈。论文规定正确标签/动作格式时 Rf=0.1；精确动作类型与参数时 Rs=1，仅正确动作类型时 Rs=0.1，否则为 0；当 tokens 出现在 </action> 之后时 Rp=-0.9，且 R=Rf+Rs+Rp。精确动作匹配被明确呈现为受实时反馈约束所必需的代理。

value.html: Evaluation reports WorkArena task success from the environment. RL optimization itself is decomposed into single-step decisions and scores the predicted next action against the oracle action rather than executing each candidate to task completion.

value_zh.html: 评测报告来自环境的 WorkArena 任务成功。RL 优化本身被分解为单步决策，并对照 oracle 动作为预测的下一步动作计分，而非将每个候选执行至任务完成。

value.html: Paper plus implementation code only. The repository contains preprocessing, reward, and training scripts with <DATA_PATH>/<MODEL_PATH> placeholders, but no data directory, trajectory manifest, complete success/failure logs, model checkpoint, Hugging Face release, tag, or GitHub Release.

value_zh.html: 仅论文加实现代码。仓库含带 <DATA_PATH>/<MODEL_PATH> 占位符的预处理、奖励与训练脚本，但无数据目录、轨迹清单、完整成功/失败日志、模型 checkpoint、Hugging Face 发布、tag 或 GitHub Release。

value.html: WorkArena task/configuration -> o3-mini configuration perturbation -> BrowserGym cheat()/Playwright oracle interaction -> rejection of invalid or unsuccessful traces -> single-step goal/state/history/target-action records -> 1,000-sample SFT warm-up and GRPO candidate rollouts -> rule reward -> policy update -> separate WorkArena evaluation.

value_zh.html: WorkArena 任务/配置 -> o3-mini 配置扰动 -> BrowserGym cheat()/Playwright oracle 交互 -> 拒绝无效或不成功轨迹 -> 单步目标/状态/历史/目标动作记录 -> 1,000 样本 SFT 预热与 GRPO 候选 rollouts -> 规则奖励 -> 策略更新 -> 单独 WorkArena 评测。

value.html: Main experiments use Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct; a backbone-transfer experiment uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. No trained checkpoint is publicly linked.

value_zh.html: 主实验使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct；骨干迁移实验使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。无公开链接的已训练 checkpoint。

value.html: o3-mini perturbs configurations and annotates the standard SFT trajectories; deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B injects long-chain reasoning for SFT-L. The GRPO reward is rule-based rather than teacher-judged.

value_zh.html: o3-mini 扰动配置并标注标准 SFT 轨迹；deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 为 SFT-L 注入长链推理。GRPO 奖励基于规则而非教师评判。

value.html: BrowserGym cheat() Playwright scripts generate oracle-like trajectories; the current policy generates groups of single-step candidates during GRPO.

value_zh.html: BrowserGym cheat() Playwright 脚本生成类 oracle 轨迹；当前策略在 GRPO 期间生成单步候选组。

value.html: Ten reserved training configurations for each of 33 WorkArena task types, followed by o3-mini perturbation; exact configuration IDs and a task-to-record manifest are not released.

value_zh.html: 33 种 WorkArena 任务类型各有十个预留训练配置，随后 o3-mini 扰动；精确配置 IDs 与任务到记录清单未发布。

value.html: Oracle-like trajectories are sampled for each training configuration and decomposed by decision step. The paper does not disclose the total number of accepted trajectories, total derived steps, per-configuration retries, seeds, or the full training manifest.

value_zh.html: 对每个训练配置采样类 oracle 轨迹并按决策步骤分解。论文未披露被接受轨迹总数、派生步骤总数、每配置重试、种子或完整训练清单。

value.html: The paper denotes G candidates per state without giving G in the text. The released training script sets actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=8, but no run manifest binds that script revision to every reported experiment and the total candidate count is unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文表示每状态 G 个候选，但未在正文给出 G。已发布训练脚本设定 actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=8，但无运行清单将该脚本修订绑定到每个所报告实验，且总候选计数未知。

value.html: 0.6 for policy rollouts, as reported in the paper and set in the released training script.

value_zh.html: 策略 rollouts 为 0.6，如论文所报并在已发布训练脚本中设定。

value.html: The paper removes trajectory samples containing invalid actions or unsuccessful outcomes. Counts and reasons before and after filtering are not disclosed, and rejected artifacts are not released.

value_zh.html: 论文移除含无效动作或不成功结果的轨迹样本。过滤前后的计数与原因未披露，被拒绝产物未发布。

value.html: Paper reports 8 NVIDIA H200 141GB GPUs, SFT for one epoch with batch size 32 and learning rate 1e-4 on 1,000 randomly selected training samples, then RL batch size 128, learning rate 1e-5, and KL coefficient beta=1e-3. Total tokens, accepted record count, wall-clock time, seeds, and API cost for o3-mini are unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文报告 8 块 NVIDIA H200 141GB GPUs，SFT 一个 epoch、batch size 32、学习率 1e-4，用于 1,000 条随机选取的训练样本，然后 RL batch size 128、学习率 1e-5，以及 KL 系数 beta=1e-3。总 tokens、被接受记录计数、墙钟时间、种子与 o3-mini 的 API 成本未知。

value.html: GRPO over independent single-step decisions with group-relative advantages, clipping, and KL regularization, implemented on veRL/TinyZero. The paper compares PPO and GRPO; the released shell script requests 15 epochs, rollout group size 8, and 1e-6 actor LR, which does not exactly match every paper-level implementation value.

value_zh.html: 在独立单步决策上使用组相对优势、裁剪与 KL 正则化的 GRPO，实现于 veRL/TinyZero。论文比较 PPO 与 GRPO；已发布 shell 脚本请求 15 个 epochs、rollout 组大小 8 与 1e-6 actor LR，这与并非每一项论文级实现值完全匹配。

value.html: Synthetic, heuristic-generated ServiceNow interactions from 33 WorkArena task types, o3-mini configuration perturbations/reason annotations, optional DeepSeek distilled reasoning for SFT-L, and on-policy candidates from four open backbone sizes. Exact record-level mixture weights and teacher versions are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 来自 33 种 WorkArena 任务类型的合成、启发式生成的 ServiceNow 交互，o3-mini 配置扰动/理由标注，SFT-L 的可选 DeepSeek 蒸馏推理，以及来自四种开放骨干规模的 on-policy 候选。精确记录级混合物权重与教师版本未披露。

value.html: The paper states that training and testing configuration files are separate and reserves 330 training configurations. The released preprocessing script instead loads an external <DATA_PATH> and calls train_test_split independently for train and test, without publishing fixed indices; if run literally, those separately sampled partitions need not be disjoint.

value_zh.html: 论文称训练与测试配置文件是分离的，并预留 330 个训练配置。已发布预处理脚本则加载外部 <DATA_PATH> 并对 train 与 test 独立调用 train_test_split，未发布固定索引；若按字面运行，这些分别采样的分区不必不相交。

value.html: Training and evaluation use the same 33 WorkArena task types and ServiceNow substrate, although configuration files are reported as separate. This is within-benchmark generalization across configurations, not evidence of broad web-domain generalization.

value_zh.html: 训练与评测使用相同的 33 种 WorkArena 任务类型与 ServiceNow 基底，尽管配置文件被报告为分离。这是跨配置的基准内泛化，而非广泛 web 领域泛化的证据。

value.html: o3-mini perturbation is used to make training configurations unique relative to existing BrowserGym and WorkArena configurations. No model-pretraining overlap audit, exact-match report, or released perturbed-config manifest supports a broader decontamination claim.

value_zh.html: o3-mini 扰动用于使训练配置相对于既有 BrowserGym 与 WorkArena 配置唯一。无模型预训练重叠审计、精确匹配报告或已发布的扰动配置清单支持更广的去污染主张。

value.html: The paper keeps successful oracle-like trajectories after removing invalid-action and unsuccessful samples. Neither accepted trajectories nor rejected/failed trajectories are publicly released, and their counts are unknown. Aggregate benchmark success rates do not substitute for complete success/failure episode records.

value_zh.html: 论文在移除无效动作与不成功样本后保留成功的类 oracle 轨迹。被接受轨迹与被拒绝/失败轨迹均未公开发布，其计数未知。汇总基准成功率不能替代完整成功/失败 episode 记录。

value.html: Training is not independently replayable from the repository because the dataset and base/warm-up checkpoints are external placeholders, fixed split indices and seeds are absent, WorkArena is remote-hosted, and no environment/database snapshot is pinned.

value_zh.html: 训练无法从仓库独立重放，因为数据集与基座/预热 checkpoints 是外部占位符，固定划分索引与种子缺失，WorkArena 为远程托管，且无环境/数据库快照被钉扎。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Exact next-action matching is only a surrogate for environment-level success and may reject alternative valid actions.
The reward evaluates tag syntax, action type, and parameters, but not whether the written reasoning is faithful or causally useful.
The paper acknowledges that even the sparse reward can incentivize superficial reward hacking.
Dense-reward ablations collapsed toward frequent actions or excessive post-termination actions, illustrating exploitable proxy signals.

At pinned commit 1ee2619b..., webagent.py does not implement the paper equations literally: it relaxes several tag checks, returns scores on a different scale, and contains an apparently inverted postfix-length branch.
精确下一动作匹配只是环境级成功的代理，可能拒绝其他有效动作。
奖励评估标签句法、动作类型与参数，但不评估所写推理是否忠实或因果上有用。
论文承认即使稀疏奖励也可激励表面的奖励劫持。
稠密奖励消融塌向频繁动作或过多终止后动作，说明可被利用的代理信号。
在钉扎 commit 1ee2619b... 处，webagent.py 并未按字面实现论文公式：它放宽若干标签检查、以不同尺度返回分数，并含有一处显然反转的后缀长度分支。
Workplace-only WorkArena coverage limits transfer to other web domains.
A gap remains to stronger commercial agents, despite selected comparisons with GPT-4o.
Same-task-family evaluation can overstate generalization beyond WorkArena.
Reward and preprocessing code drift from the paper specification and lack a bound run manifest.
Filtering removes unsuccessful/invalid traces, preventing audit of failure coverage and selection bias.
仅职场的 WorkArena 覆盖限制向其他 web 域的迁移。
尽管有与 GPT-4o 的选定比较，与更强商业智能体仍有差距。
同一任务族评测可能夸大超出 WorkArena 的泛化。
奖励与预处理代码偏离论文规格，且缺少绑定的运行清单。
过滤移除不成功/无效轨迹，阻碍对失败覆盖与选择偏差的审计。

value.html: The authors state that training and evaluation data are synthetic heuristic-generated trajectories in controlled benchmark environments and use no real-user sensitive data. No independent content or leakage audit of generated text is reported.

value_zh.html: 作者称训练与评测数据是受控基准环境中的合成启发式生成轨迹，且不使用真实用户敏感数据。未报告对生成文本的独立内容或泄漏审计。

value.html: The ACL paper is CC BY 4.0. The GitHub repository exposes no repository-level LICENSE and GitHub reports no detected license; Notice.txt only credits ByteDance. Some inherited source files contain Apache-2.0 headers, which does not establish a license for the entire repository or for the unavailable training data.

value_zh.html: ACL 论文为 CC BY 4.0。GitHub 仓库未暴露仓库级 LICENSE，且 GitHub 报告未检测到许可；Notice.txt 仅归功 ByteDance。部分继承源文件含 Apache-2.0 头，这并不为整个仓库或不可用训练数据确立许可。

value.html: The paper documents the conceptual pipeline but publishes no configuration IDs, trajectory IDs, step IDs, rejection ledger, teacher-response ledger, rollout manifest, checkpoint hashes, or evaluation episode logs. The code revision is pin-able but its <DATA_PATH> and <MODEL_PATH> inputs are unresolved.

value_zh.html: 论文记录了概念流水线，但未发布配置 IDs、轨迹 IDs、步骤 IDs、拒绝台账、教师响应台账、rollout 清单、checkpoint 哈希或评测 episode 日志。代码修订可钉扎，但其 <DATA_PATH> 与 <MODEL_PATH> 输入未解析。

value.html: Formal paper: ACL Anthology 2026.findings-eacl.3, March 2026, pages 34-49, DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.findings-eacl.3. arXiv:2505.22942v2 was last revised 2025-06-08. Code: main commit 1ee2619b95403764da30308035ff4dbcbc9a74c1 dated 2025-06-01; GitHub reports two commits and no tags or Releases.

value_zh.html: 正式论文：ACL Anthology 2026.findings-eacl.3，2026 年 3 月，第 34-49 页，DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.findings-eacl.3。arXiv:2505.22942v2 最后修订于 2025-06-08。代码：main commit 1ee2619b95403764da30308035ff4dbcbc9a74c1，日期 2025-06-01；GitHub 报告两次 commits，无 tags 或 Releases。
